user.title: Choose a saber
user.description: Pick the saber to add. It must be awake (hold the button) and the Xeno Configurator app must be closed.

data_description.address: Sabers found by Bluetooth. Only awake sabers appear; Home Assistant connects briefly to check the one you pick.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

abort.already_in_progress: Setup of this saber is already in progress.
abort.no_devices_found: No compatible saber (Xenopixel V3 board) found. Wake it up and try again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the saber. Make sure it is awake and within range, and that the Xeno Configurator app is closed, then try again.

data.wled_udp: Color sync: listen for WLED broadcasts

data_description.idle_disconnect: 0 = stay connected (live state, but the phone app cannot connect). Otherwise Home Assistant connects on demand and releases the saber after this delay.
data_description.keepalive: 0 = off (recommended). Any other value resends the current brightness every N seconds so the saber never goes to sleep. WARNING: this keeps the saber's board and Bluetooth radio awake all the time and WILL DRAIN THE BATTERY, even with the blade off. Use it only while the saber is on its charger, or for short sessions. Requires 'Disconnect after idle' = 0.
data_description.sync_light: Optional. While the Color sync switch is on, the blade copies this light's on/off state, color and brightness. Turning that light on ignites the blade.
data_description.wled_udp: While Color sync is on, listen on UDP port 21324 for WLED sync packets (in WLED: Settings > Sync Interfaces > Send notifications on change). These packets are not authenticated: any device on your network can drive the blade unless you set a source address below.
data_description.wled_udp_source: Optional. Only obey WLED packets sent from this IPv4 address.

error.keepalive_needs_persistent: Keepalive needs a permanent connection: set 'Disconnect after idle' to 0.
error.invalid_ip: Enter an IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.50.

entry_not_loaded.message: {name} is not loaded. Check that the saber is set up and reachable.

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant is not allowed to access {path}. Put the file under /media, or add its folder to allowlist_external_dirs in configuration.yaml.

file_exists.message: {path} already exists. Set overwrite to replace it.

blade_must_be_off.message: Turn the blade off first: the saber does not accept this while it is lit.

confirm_required.message: This action can leave the saber unusable if it goes wrong. Set confirm to true to go ahead.

firmware_file_protected.message: {path} is the saber's firmware update file: writing or deleting it would change its firmware at the next start, so this integration refuses it.

no_sound_files.message: No recognizable sound files in {path}. Files must be WAVs named like hum.wav, clash1.wav or clash (1).wav, or be in folders named after the sound type.

wav_format.message: {count} file(s) cannot be played by the saber, which needs 44.1 kHz, 16-bit, mono PCM WAV: {files}

font_not_found.message: The saber has no font folder {font} (it has: {available}). Use an existing folder to replace a font, or {next} to add a new one.

bad_archive.message: {path} cannot be used as a font: {error}

not_enough_space.message: Not enough space on the saber: the font needs about {needed} MB and {free} MB are free. Delete the old font first (delete_first, after exporting it) or use a smaller font.

font_not_in_backup.message: Font {font} is not in the backup (it has: {available}).

device_not_saber.message: Device {device_id} is not a Xeno saber.

settings_write_held_back.message: {path} is part of the saber's settings. Changing or deleting them is not available in this release: it has not been tested on a real saber.

keepalive_battery_drain.title: Keepalive is draining the battery of {name}
keepalive_battery_drain.description: Keepalive is on for {name} (every {interval} s). The saber cannot go to sleep: its board and Bluetooth radio stay powered and the battery will drain, even with the blade off. To stop it, set the keepalive interval to 0 in the integration's options (Settings > Devices & services > Xeno Saber BLE > Configure).

upload_sound_font.name: Upload sound font
upload_sound_font.description: Sends a folder of WAV files to one of the saber's font folders over Bluetooth, replacing that font. Files are renamed to the saber's convention (hum (1).wav, clash (1).wav...). Expect several minutes per megabyte; the blade must be off.

folder.name: Folder or zip
folder.description: Folder or .zip file on the Home Assistant host with the font's WAV files (44.1 kHz, 16-bit, mono). Subfolders named after a sound type are read too.

font.name: Font
font.description: Number of the font folder on the saber, starting at 1. The next free number adds a new font, as in the app.

name.name: Name
name.description: Optional new name for the font.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Delete the old font's files that the new one does not overwrite.

delete_first.name: Delete old font first
delete_first.description: Delete all files of the target font before sending, to make room. Export it first: the old font cannot be recovered otherwise.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only show how the files would be named; send nothing.

export_sound_font.name: Export sound font
export_sound_font.description: Copies every sound file of one font from the saber's card into a .zip on the Home Assistant host, to back it up or edit it. Upload sound font accepts the zip back. As slow as an upload; the blade must be off.

font.name: Font
font.description: Number of the font folder on the saber's card, starting at 1.

destination.name: Destination
destination.description: Zip file to write on the Home Assistant host.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace the destination if it exists.

backup_saber.name: Back up saber
backup_saber.description: Copies everything on the saber's storage into a .zip on the Home Assistant host: every font, config.ini, the custom button mapping if any, the system sounds, and a description of the saber and its settings. The zip is laid out like a Xeno SD card. Over Bluetooth this takes hours for a full saber; the blade must be off.

destination.name: Destination
destination.description: Zip file to write on the Home Assistant host.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace the destination if it exists.

fonts.name: Fonts
fonts.description: Font folders to include; all of them if empty.

include_system_sounds.name: System sounds
include_system_sounds.description: Also save the voice prompts and menu sounds of the setting folder (about 430 small files). The saber cannot list them, so the ones it does not have are skipped.

restore_backup.name: Restore backup
restore_backup.description: Writes the fonts of a backup made by Back up saber (or a zip of a Xeno SD card) back to the saber, with their names. Fonts on the saber are replaced; missing ones are created if they are the next free folders. The settings and voice prompts in the backup are not written. Over Bluetooth a large restore takes hours; the blade must be off.

source.name: Source
source.description: Backup zip on the Home Assistant host.

fonts.name: Fonts
fonts.description: Font folders of the backup to restore; all of them if empty.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only check the backup and return what would be written.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Required: the fonts restored replace the ones on the saber.

list_sound_fonts.name: List sound fonts
list_sound_fonts.description: Returns the font folders on the saber's card, their names, and the card's usage.

list_sound_files.name: List sound files
list_sound_files.description: Returns the sound files of one font, grouped by type.

font.name: Font
font.description: Number of the font folder on the saber's card, starting at 1.

rename_sound_font.name: Rename sound font
rename_sound_font.description: Changes the name the saber shows for a font.

font.name: Font
font.description: Number of the font folder on the saber's card, starting at 1.

play_sound.name: Play sound
play_sound.description: Plays a sound file from the saber's card, or stops playback when no path is given.

path.name: Path
path.description: File on the saber, for example /3/hum (1).wav. Leave empty to stop.

upload_file.name: Upload file
upload_file.description: Sends a file to the saber's card, for example a sound file. The saber's settings (config.ini and the setting folder) cannot be written. The blade must be off.

source.name: Source
source.description: File on the Home Assistant host.

destination.name: Destination
destination.description: Path on the saber, for example /3/hum (1).wav.

download_file.name: Download file
download_file.description: Copies a file from the saber's card to Home Assistant, for example config.ini as a backup. The blade must be off.

source.name: Source
source.description: Path on the saber, for example config.ini.

destination.name: Destination
destination.description: File to write on the Home Assistant host.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace the destination if it exists.

copy_file.name: Copy file
copy_file.description: Copies a file from one place on the saber's card to another. The saber's settings (config.ini and the setting folder) cannot be overwritten.

delete_file.name: Delete file
delete_file.description: Deletes a file from the saber's card. There is no undo. The saber's settings (config.ini and the setting folder) cannot be deleted.

path.name: Path
path.description: File on the saber, for example /3/clash (9).wav.
